WITH project_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    p.arcregistry,
    p.fundflux,
    AVG(ss.boxy / NULLIF(ss.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS ss
    ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux
),
source_stats AS (
  SELECT
    fundflux,
    AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS project_count
  FROM project_ratios
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
source_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(project_count) AS avg_project_count
  FROM source_stats
),
kept_sources AS (
  SELECT s.avg_ratio, s.project_count, a.avg_project_count
  FROM source_stats AS s
  CROSS JOIN source_average AS a
  WHERE s.project_count > a.avg_project_count
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
  SUM(project_count) AS total_distinct_projects,
  AVG(project_count - avg_project_count) AS avg_excess_project_count
FROM kept_sources

assumptions.assumption: A project counts for a funding source when it has at least one matching spatial record; each project contributes one average ratio, first averaging its non-null boxy/boxz ratios. A zero boxz is excluded as an undefined ratio.
